title: Reality Gate 34-Candidate Exploratory Veto Pilot
question: Within the exact 34-candidate non-Jain-overlap complete-case GDPa1 cohort that made TRIAL-SELECTOR-EXTERNAL-001 inconclusive, can strictly nested sequence-derived prediction identify a high-confidence developability-failure tail while preserving most experimentally clean candidates?

prior_work_boundary.CPG-002: INCONCLUSIVE_COVERAGE; composite and hard-veto arms both had 0.0 declared gated-liability rate across four GDPa1 folds.
prior_work_boundary.TRIAL-SELECTOR-EXTERNAL-001: INCONCLUSIVE_EXTERNAL_COHORT because the predeclared >=40-candidate complete-case non-Jain-overlap bar was not met; observed usable cohort is expected to be 34.
prior_work_boundary.RGV-001: Frozen external validation target on independent GDPa3; currently INCONCLUSIVE_EXTERNAL_COVERAGE because external truth is unavailable to CI.
prior_work_boundary.new_question: This pilot tests toxic-tail vetoing inside the exact historical 34-candidate cohort; it is not external validation and cannot upgrade RGV-001.

cohort_binding.overlap_rule: exact normalized antibody-name equality against frozen Jain canonical candidate_ids
cohort_binding.missingness_rule: complete case across all eight frozen Trial Selector external assays after Jain overlap exclusion

dispositions.UNKNOWN: No high-confidence veto. Candidate remains worth measuring.

nesting.outer: leave-one-antibody-out over the exact P34 cohort
nesting.inner: leave-one-antibody-out within each outer training set
nesting.model_selection: Ridge alpha selected independently per assay from [0.1,1,10,100] by inner OOF MSE
nesting.confidence_selection: single residual quantile selected only from the outer-training inner-OOF predictions

claim_boundary.if_signal: On this exact 34-candidate GDPa1-derived exploratory cohort, a strictly nested sequence-only confidence veto showed toxic-tail enrichment while retaining at least 90% of experimentally clean candidates. This is pilot evidence only and requires independent validation.

kill_condition: If the verdict is NO_PILOT_VETO_SIGNAL, close the learned selector/veto line. Do not rescue it by changing the cohort, viability thresholds, retention floor, feature family, or significance bar after observing this result. RGV-001 may remain frozen only as a pre-existing external falsifier if genuinely independent truth later becomes available.
